description: Self-contained intra-repository linkage contracts for @snowui-design-system/styles when cloned standalone from GitHub.

points.title: Utility & Responsive Stylesheets <-> Bilingual Usage Guides & Generator Sync
points.triggerSignal: Added or updated static utilities, base rules, or responsive utility allowlist
immediate: Synchronize utility class tables in both SNOWUI_USAGE.md (English) and SNOWUI_USAGE.zh.md (Chinese)
Regenerate snowui-responsive.css via pnpm generate:responsive instead of editing generated rules by hand (keep within raw/gzip size budget)

points.title: Theme Variables Entrypoint (snowui-themes.css) Integrity
points.triggerSignal: Updated light/dark theme color or surface CSS custom properties
points.exemptWhen: Synced deterministically from upstream themes.css source
immediate: Ensure light and dark theme token sets remain symmetric and snowui.css continues to import ./snowui-themes.css cleanly
